overview: A traumatized psychic, after receiving a vision from beyond the grave, must use her ability once again to confront a killer.

title: Death at the Dinner Party
overview: When a star psychology student dies during a faculty party, Andrea Gibbs and her son Ethan are drawn into the dangerous manipulations of renowned professor Alan Jackson, a man determined to bury the truth at any cost.

title: Shark Thrash
overview: A small and touristy beachside town is hit by a storm the size of which nobody could have predicted. A family who just arrived tries to escape, but gets stuck in the quickly rising waters. They try to figure a way out with the help of some locals, but any progress is shut down when the sharks make their way onto the flooded streets. The family and locals must now find a way to survive as the waters rise.

title: Telescope
overview: Stumbling on the mythical House of Lost Things, an explorer must choose between her missing childhood stuffed animal and a future-telling telescope with the answer to all her fears.

title: Grizzly Attack
overview: Stranded at a remote cabin, a grieving family faces a relentless bear that tests their shelter and forces a final stand.

title: Grizzly Bear Massacre
overview: A cabin getaway turns deadly when a rogue bear stalks five college friends, forcing the survivors to flee through the forest at night with a ranger guiding them.

title: Beyond Norm
overview: A reporter follows a small community of dropouts as she seeks the true reasons behind their new life in the wild.

title: Strong
overview: Lami Sawa, a radiant spiritual mentor and accomplished architect, appears to live an idyllic life with her devoted husband, Sota. Rooted in love and faith, their marriage is shattered when Sota is accused of infidelity and the murder of a woman, plunging Lami into doubt, scandal, and a fight for truth.

title: Damnation Empire
overview: A man is about to be executed. Before, during, or after his death, he remembers fragments of his past, and navigates to find and save himself.

title: The Molding
overview: To make the superior human race, every person in this isolated dystopian community is paired and molded into one being at the age of 16. Choosing one person's mind and one person's body. It is not so easy to decline the process.

title: Karaa
overview: A series of bizarre, comical crimes spirals into chaos, taking a dark turn when characters become trapped in crocodile-infested floodwaters, leading to a deadly encounter with the predators.

title: The Last Laugh: Stephen Colbert
overview: For more than a decade, Stephen Colbert has sat at the center of late night, where comedy, politics and culture collide. As he prepares to take the desk for the final time, The Last Laugh turns its lens on both the show and the man, exploring what audiences stand to lose when one of satire’s sharpest and most thoughtful voices signs off. The hour also examines the broader cultural and political forces surrounding the end of Colbert’s late-night run and the future of outspoken comedy in an evolving landscape.  Anchoring the hour is a dynamic lineup of interviewees spanning comedy, journalism and cultural criticism. The special features appearances from CNN Anchor and Chief Washington Correspondent Jake Tapper and comedians Jordan Carlos and Gianmarco Soresi, alongside key creative voices from The Colbert Report including Allison Silverman and Richard Dahm, each offering insight into the scope and lasting influence of Colbert’s work.

title: Philippe-Audrey Larrue-St-Jacques: Enfant du siècle
overview: Philippe-Audrey's solo show: his deadpan humor, sometimes scathing, and his slightly offbeat, funny dandyish appearance prove to be a unique offering that lives up to expectations.

title: Medusa
overview: Poseidon demands Medusa’s submission. Hoping to protect her, her sisters send her to live with the priestesses of Athena’s temple. But the god of the sea emerges from the waves and rapes the young woman, defiling the temple. To punish her for this desecration, Athena turns Medusa into a monstrous creature: her hair becomes a nest of snakes and her gaze turns anyone who looks at her to stone. This terrifying power arouses the lust of heroes, who pursue her in her exile…

title: Enter Gustaffson
overview: The legendary anonymous painter known as Gustaffson reveals his identity in a groundbreaking documentary.

title: Unfinished Business
overview: Two ghosts are forced together in a seemingly endless eternity, and they find themselves at their wits' end as they fail to make any meaningful connection.

title: Lara Ricote: Little Tiny Wet Show (baptism)
overview: Stand up comedy performance of Lara Ricote's show "Little Tiny Wet Show (baptism)"

title: White Wasteland
overview: On a snowy wasteland a body awakens with no memories. By following a trail of footprints in the snow he reaches a car, where he finds a diary and driver's license with a name: Eerik Traat. From the last diary entry, Eerik reads about eye drops that help visualize memories and memory-erasing tablets. In the hope of restoring his memories and identity, Eerik decides to recreate the memories by using the eye drops. At first, everything seems normal, but gradually inconsistencies and distortions begin to arise.

title: Chandarege Wife
overview: 'Chandarege Wife' is a Sinhala drama focusing on a wife trying to sustain her marriage to a filmmaker while facing hidden truths and a crumbling relationship.

title: Lo Naveena
overview: A rustic village boy and his wild friends embark on a chaotic, heartwarming quest to win the heart of his beloved Asha.

title: Squatch
overview: After discovering a Sasquatch in the Smoky Mountains, park rangers Robert and Sam find themselves in over their heads when tech giant Alphazon plans to destroy its habitat. With no real authority and even less of a plan, they decide to relocate the creature themselves, driving it cross-country to the Pacific Northwest. Watch as Robert and Sam try to do one small, wildly impractical good thing.

title: Fight Dirty
overview: When wealthy Queen Bee Kenzie makes a deal with high school bad boy Clay to be her fake boyfriend and bodyguard, she unknowingly steps into his dangerous world of illegal underground fighting - quickly igniting an undeniable attraction.

title: Foot Finders
overview: Embark on a wild adventure as Kyle Evans, a Sasquatch-hunting reality TV star, goes all in on a last ditch effort to save his failing show.

title: The Beloved
overview: The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his new project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. Living together on set will foster a closeness they haven’t shared for years, but it will also reopen old wounds that never healed.

title: A Man and A Woman
overview: In the early spring of 2021, a man and a woman flew to Hong Kong at the same time, and while waiting to enter the mainland, they stayed in the same hotel, separated by a wall. During the short intersection of their lives, the two confided in each other about the pressure they were burdened with and found a spiritual harbor in Hong Kong, where tenacious vitality was blooming. And before the answer is revealed, the choice stops abruptly.

title: Double Freedom
overview: Misael works alone with his axe, cutting down trees in the woods. An unexpected responsibility upends his life, and the logic of his days fades away in a nature where human reason holds no meaning.

title: Bullying, our lives after
overview: What if we changed viewpoints? "Bullying, our lives after" highlights the suffering of adults who were once bullied pupils. Ten, twenty or thirty years later, trauma is still present. Following Nathalie, Laurine and Samuel, this movie shows the long-term implications of bullying, pointing out a real failure of the educational institution and a major public health issue.

title: Full Phil
overview: Wealthy American industrialist Philip Doom attempts to reconnect with his daughter Madeleine during a luxurious trip to Paris. Unfortunately, French cuisine, a 1950s horror film, and an intrusive hotel employee disrupt their stay.

title: Signs of Mr. Plum
overview: Contrary to his family’s expectations and despite having lost one eye, Karol Śliwka leaves his rural home to study art in Warsaw. He decides to be a designer of graphic signs. He fills communist Poland with his works and defines the country’s visual landscape. His signs do not hang in galleries, but are present in Polish homes, in Polish streets, at institutions and workplaces. At the same time, he leads an ordinary family life, which he documents passionately over the years. This extremely gifted artist is still considered one of the greatest sign designers in the world.

title: STRAIGHT EDGE
overview: Desperate to escape his dead-end life, Matt (Chris Lovejoy) recruits his derelict friends to rob the neighborhood mob's card game. With his crew's reputation on the line, Denicio (Joe Graziano) is tasked with hunting down the trio and finding the money. Matt is forced to choose between his past or a life with the woman he loves.

title: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
overview: When a suspect in a forgery case is murdered and the prosecutor goes missing, Hannah and Chad must uncover how the two cases are connected and solve them in time for the trial.

title: Skotos
overview: When socially anxious Cecille attends a house party to get out of her shell, her perception begins to fracture as darkness consumes the room and people begin to disappear, forcing her to confront the fears she’s tried to outrun.

title: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
overview: Lisa and Al Robertson, known from Duck Dynasty, fell hard and fast believing they had found a once-in-a-lifetime love. But betrayal and unspoken pain slowly fracture what they built together. When the truth comes to light, both must confront everything they thought they knew about love and loyalty — and decide if their marriage and faith are worth fighting for.

title: Desire/Sleep
overview: A cat lounges on a chair, while the sound of birdsong and traffic echoes through a window.

title: INCARNATUS
overview: Brian, a manosphere crazed incel reaches his breaking point

title: I Probably Am a Lonely One
overview: A wife tries to find some kind of connection with her husband, Edward, to no avail.

title: Last Resort
overview: A strained sibling road trip spirals into chaos after a motel stop in the middle of nowhere reveals that some places are more dangerous than they seem.

title: Precious Thing
overview: A daughter discusses the overlapping issues with her current life and her mother's previous and current experiences through phone calls over the course of many months while away at college. Life events cause conversations to get more serious and pressing, beginning to affect both women's lives as they cling to each other for comfort and consistency.

title: Deep Within
overview: A man struggling with inner conflicts embarks on a journey where the boundaries between reality and the subconscious gradually begin to blur.

title: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
overview: Profiles the double Oscar winner, who helmed some of the most well-respected movies of all time, via never-before-seen archive and contributions from leading film directors. Haunted by the shadow of his dismissive father and his puritan upbringing, Lean was married six times, and he created layered and complex narratives in his work while struggling to find connection and meaning in his personal life.

title: I'll Be Gone in June
overview: In search of freedom and the American Dream, 16-year-old German exchange student Franny sets out to the USA in 2001. But instead of New York or California, she ends up in the emptiness of a small town in New Mexico. In the wake of 9/11, Franny drifts through her exchange life in a city left behind and forgotten by America. In the endless desert, Franny, the 'alien', meets military host families, bored teens, strange characters of all kinds, and a soulmate – the melancholic Elliott, who despite his young age already represents the opposite of this dream and seems to have failed in life before he even crosses the threshold of adulthood. There is little time left for the two of them until June – until Franny will leave again. What can they do to stop the time from running out?

title: Dora
overview: A family retreats to the seaside, far from the bustle of Seoul. Their daughter, Dora, suffers from a mysterious illness. Her discovery of love unleashes a force as powerful as it is dangerous, with far-reaching consequences for those around her…

title: Es frisst
overview: After a botched robbery, a young gangster couple takes a mother and her daughter hostage and ends up in a forgotten forest cemetery on the edge of a disused industrial estate.

title: The Station
overview: As Layal runs a women-only fuel station in a segregated war-torn town, she is faced with her 12-year-old brother’s growing desire to break free and become a ‘man’. When Layal’s estranged sister unexpectedly shows up with a proposition for their brother, the siblings’ relationship is put to the test.

title: All the Lovers in the Night
overview: Freelance proofreader Fuyuko's carefully ordered life in solitude begins to transform after meeting Mitsutsuka, a quiet high school physics teacher.

title: Holding Water
overview: Over the course of an afternoon in late spring, two longtime friends reunite under a mulberry tree to confront the ways their time apart has changed them.

title: Voidance
overview: To join the elite ATIC Guard, Alana Toro must pass one final test: enter a simulation, prevent a terrorist attack, and prove her loyalty. Every mistake resets the clock. Every death disappears - except in her memory, where the weight keeps building. The more Alana learns, the more she begins to question the organisation she fought so hard to join.

title: Avedon
overview: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

title: DON'T
overview: Based on a true story, this short animated film illustrating the difficulties faced by a person suffering from mental illness. This black and white film, inspired by the classic style of sequencing, is animated using rotoscoping to convey realistic emotions and movements.

title: Bewildered
overview: Set in 1977, "Bewildered" follows Terry Perkins, a young, small-town girl who enters a hit game show for the chance to win $5,000 in hopes of saving her sick father, only to discover the charismatic host leads a cannibalistic cult!

title: Dinner
overview: Our short film captures the comedic chaos of a quintessential romantic dinner interrupted by a mischievous, scene-stealing rat. Through intricate character animation and expressive physical comedy, we explore the hilarious tension between high-stakes elegance and an uninvited, tiny antagonist, creating a delightful story about finding laughter in the midst of a perfect plan gone wrong.

title: La Tarara
overview: A symbolic short film exploring the relationship between an aunt and her nephew through a blend of fashion, visual arts, and cinematic storytelling. Part of the three-film "Where Talent Ignites" project showcasing Spanish creativity.

title: Oil
overview: A mother takes her young son to the beach in an attempt to rebuild their relationship. But what begins as a day of reconciliation shifts when a mysterious presence emerges from the sea, drawing them both into a journey of fear and mystery.

title: Friends Until the End
overview: When a luxurious weekend brunch turns deadly after their host is found mysteriously murdered, a group of longtime friends must unravel buried secrets and survive a series of chilling attacks.

title: Exception culturelle, la bataille qui a sauvé le cinéma français
Jônetsu Tairiku : Iyo Sky
overview: WWE, the world's largest professional wrestling organization, is said to be watched by over 1 billion people in more than 150 countries through television and streaming. The annual "WrestleMania" event attracts nearly 60,000 spectators, creating an excitement comparable to the American football "Super Bowl. "Only top wrestlers from around the world step into the ring. In 2018, a Japanese woman professional wrestler joined WWE. A former gymnast, she captivated audiences with her acrobatic moves, utilizing her flexibility and agility. And last year, she rose to become the WWE Women's World Champion. That's Iyo Sky. When Iyo appears in front of the venue, a huge cheer erupts. "IYO! IYO!". Autographs, high-fives, hugs, two-shot photos... Her popularity is soaring across America.

title: Zugzwang!
overview: In the shadow of war, a disgraced soldier is discharged back to his home town. In the search for his girlfriend, he is drawn into a game he does not want to play.

title: Internet Famous
overview: Frank, a middle-aged family man, is convinced internet fame is his last shot at making his life mean something. When he promises his wife he'll go viral in a year, Frank's 365 days spent recklessly pursuing views and likes results in injuries, hospital bills, and chaos within the family. For Frank, success is only one viral video away — no matter the cost.

title: Daughter in a Box
overview: A seemingly independent woman moves her ailing parents into her home and finds herself back in the emotional constraints of her childhood.

title: Power Ballad
overview: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick’s songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves - even if it means risking everything he cares about.

title: Strawberries
overview: Hasna leaves her native Morocco to work as a seasonal laborer picking strawberries in Huelva, Andalucia.

title: Corporate Retreat
overview: Blending the dread of survival horror with dark laughs and shocking twists, "Corporate Retreat" centers around a group of young executives whose luxury team-building trip descends into a bloody fight for survival against a vengeful retreat leader.

title: Notre fils
overview: The obstacle-strewn journey of Romain and Antoine, a homosexual couple, involved in a long and difficult adoption process. After five years of waiting, they see their adoption application stalled for largely societal reasons: the system's reluctance to place children with a male couple, particularly in so-called “late” adoptions. Despite their sincere love and deep desire to become parents, they encounter prejudice, such as being required to prove the presence of female role models in their social circle.

title: Aquí
overview: In a new land where everyone receives a new name and begins again without a past, Simón takes responsibility for David, a child he met on the crossing to a new life. Driven by an inexplicable conviction, he sets out to find the boy’s mother despite the fact David remembers nothing about her. When he recognizes Inés as the right woman, she accepts the role and an unlikely bond forms between them. While society imposes rules and treats difference as a threat, David resists being shaped and stands for imagination and freedom.

title: La Perra
overview: On a remote, wind-lashed island off the Chilean coast, Silvia earns her living harvesting  seaweed and shares a quiet life with her partner. When she adopts a stray puppy, Yuri, her days fill with joy, love, and a tenderness that stirs a long-suppressed longing for motherhood. But Yuri’s sudden disappearance reawakens a haunting childhood trauma, forcing Silvia to confront a past she has never truly left behind.

title: Hamletmachine
overview: Hamlet and Ophelia reckon with their doomed narratives. Adapted from the 1977 East German Heiner Müller play of the same name.

title: Spring
overview: A town of 40 000 inhabitants in south-eastern Ukraine is occupied by Russia. Andriy, a 35-year-old Ukrainian priest, sees his church turned into a morgue. He is forced to guard the bodies of Ukrainian civilians who have been shot until the Russians come to collect them. Every three weeks, the Russians collect the bodies and bury them in mass graves to cover up their crimes. For several months, the priest resists, secretly returning the bodies to their families. But winter is approaching and the ground is too frozen to bury the dead. How will he continue to resist as conditions deteriorate even further?

title: Dead Man Memory
overview: David, a French police officer, travels to Thailand to meet Ravi – a young boy who claims to have been a criminal named Floyd in his previous life. Alongside his colleague Joanna, David enlists the young child and utilises his expertise to track down the dangerous criminal enterprise Floyd once had ties to.

title: TRENTE
overview: An intimate documentary exploring the transition into one's thirties-a time of questioning in a world evolving faster than the one we grew up in. Seb discovers old footage from his youth and confronts past dreams with present reality.

title: Nostalgia for the Future
overview: Guided by the evocative narration of Charlotte Rampling, Nostalgia for the Future is a descent into the labyrinthine world of Chris Marker, the “best-known author of unknown films,” who spent a lifetime concealing himself behind a veil of pseudonyms and images of cats.  Moving through a constellation of personal documents and film fragments, an archivist attempts to decode the man through the material traces he left behind. By repurposing and recontextualizing Marker’s own body of work, the film treats his images as “time machines,” transforming the archive into a landscape of living memory. Nostalgia for the Future is a meditation on memory, identity, and the power our past images hold over the futures we imagine.

title: Youth
overview: An archival footage compilation exploring the nature of youth, and the passage of time.

title: In Pieces: The Musical (A Staged Concert)
overview: Be the first to experience Joey Contreras' hit new musical In Pieces, filmed LIVE during its sold-out run at The Other Palace in London.  Written and composed by Fred Ebb Award and Jonathan Larson Grant Finalist, Joey Contreras, In Pieces is a bold, contemporary new musical featuring a pop-driven score that dives into echoes of love, loss, and self-discovery by weaving the romantic journeys of six characters across three chapters of life. As friends, family, and former lovers confront old wounds and unresolved feelings, will they learn to coexist with the joy and pain of the past?  In Pieces has become a global sensation with a massive social media fanbase, tens of millions of streams, and licensed productions internationally. NOW, you can experience the staged concert from home for a limited time only.

title: Hi, Linda
overview: A naughty young man who is lazy about worship is forced to go to church to comply with his parents' demands and his desire to get to know a female church servant who really hates his appearance.

title: Bad Funeral
overview: Two friends plan a funeral for their recently deceased muslim friend in this hidden camera guerrilla comedy.

title: The Bench
overview: Two students find themselves returning to the same bench in this cryptic short thriller

title: Day One
overview: While trying to take their dying friend to see Avengers: Doomsday on opening day, a trio of close friends gets trapped on the 50th floor of a condo after a blackout kills the elevators. They must find a way down before the movie starts.

title: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom
overview: PTA moms target and frame a "nobody" mom's son. She's humiliated and cast aside as a bigger secret emerges—until they learn she's the secret billionaire behind the school. Now she decides their fate.

title: Six Months in a Pink and Blue Building
overview: Mexico City, early 90s. The day Bruno turns 11, his growing feelings for his best friend Vladimir clash with the sudden announcement that his father has HIV. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance their pain away. Thirty years later, Bruno films and reimagine the memory of what he could not quite perceive as a child.

title: 9 Temples to Heaven
overview: A family of 9 takes their grandmother on a merit-making trip to 9 temples in 1 day, hoping to prolong her life. But the trip takes an unexpected turn.

title: Sight Unseen
overview: Three siblings inherit their estranged father's rural cabin after his mysterious death. They slowly realize someone, or something, still lives there.

title: Diamond
overview: Joe Diamond is out of time with a traumatic past and an uncanny ability to solve crimes, using wit and observation to peel back hidden truths.

title: W.E.B. Du Bois: Rebel With a Cause
overview: Explore the life and legacy of notable Black scholar and civil rights pioneer W.E.B. Du Bois. From his birth, just five years after the Emancipation Proclamation; to his death, on the eve of the March on Washington in 1963, his legacy as an activist continues to resonate today.

title: People Magazine Investigates: The Secrets of the Twelve Tribes Cult
overview: Gene Spriggs forms the Twelve Tribes in Tennessee with teens and disenchanted hippies; the group later gains a cult reputation and faces accusations of child abuse, forced labor, and strict devotion to what members say is God's will.

title: Florescence
overview: A young married couple retreat to an English country house in an attempt to salvage Lucy's worsening mental health. John's strict instructions and their self-imposed isolation pushes their relationship to breaking point and Lucy begins to experience strange phenomena in the house.

title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
overview: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

title: That They May Be One
overview: Uncovers a remarkable story of God’s providence unfolding for more than a century. From the urgent prayers of St. Elena Guerra, which inspired Pope Leo XIII to consecrate the twentieth century to the Holy Spirit, to the dramatic outpouring of the Spirit in Topeka, the historic revival at Azusa Street, and the surprising awakening among Catholics at Duquesne University in 1967, a powerful thread emerges.

title: “Vaterland” or A Bule Named Yanto
overview: When German-Indonesian Yanto (mid 20s) visits his younger sister in Yogyakarta, he expects a simple reunion – until he realises she belongs more effortlessly than he ever has. As envy and dissonance between siblings surface, Yantos journey becomes a bittersweet exploration of mixed-race identity.

title: Abandonados
overview: Abandonados, a case by Carles Porta, revisits one of the most unsettling episodes in recent Spanish history. Forty years after being abandoned at a train station in Barcelona, three siblings embark on an investigation to uncover their identity and their past. Through testimonies, archival material, and a long-term investigation, the work reflects on memory, identity, and the search for truth.

title: What Remains: Die Toten Hosen – The Last Album
overview: In "What Remains: Die Toten Hosen – The Last Album", director Eric Friedler exclusively follows the iconic rock band over the course of two years as they create their final studio album. Never before has the band allowed themselves to be observed so intimately in the studio. The film crew also goes behind the scenes of a European tour that the band scheduled in between their studio sessions. The result is a moving tribute to a band that has written German music history and continues to inspire generations to this day.

title: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
overview: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

title: Goodnight Lamby
overview: Three-year-old Zia searches for her missing stuffed Lamby through her father’s surreal sculpture-a vast world of oceans, caves, and outer space. Her quest becomes a journey of courage, wonder, and self-discovery.

title: Torino Shadow
overview: A woman travels from southern China to Turin, Italy, to see her husband. But an unexpected departure leaves her to find herself again, and to find cinema.

title: Pinay Kamasutra
overview: Hosted by Ataska, Pinay Kama Sutra returns for another sizzling volume as she explores fifteen daring positions inspired by iconic VMX movie moments. Get in rhythm, feel every move, and prepare for a hotter, sweatier experience.

title: Caravelle 114
overview: At the height of Brazil’s military dictatorship, a flight would change the fate of everyone on board. Among the passengers were a mother, her two young children, and militants from VAR-Palmares with a daring plan: to divert Flight 114 to Cuba.  Caravelle 114 reconstructs, in fiction, the events behind the hijacking that defied the Brazilian dictatorship.

title: Secrets de la Science : Sommes-nous seuls dans l'Univers ?
The Final Battle
overview: In the early days of liberation, banditry is rampant. Xiang Yang, a reconnaissance platoon leader of the People's Liberation Army, is ordered to go to Sanwanli to suppress bandits. Going undercover, he reunites with his elder brother Xiang Tian, who has become the third leader of the bandit gang Qingfeng Stronghold, and they have a fierce confrontation. Yang remains steadfast in his convictions as he outwits intelligence, burns the granary, and coordinates with his comrades outside to launch a siege. Facing the brutal counterattacks of bandit leaders like Blind Long, Yang leads troops to fight bloody battles. With the sacrifice of his brother Tian, they finally completely wipe out the bandit gang. After the battle of blood and fire, this land finally welcomes the dawn of peace.

title: A Walk
overview: A man goes for a walk that gradually becomes more glitchy.

title: World War Bigfoot
overview: When his platoon is ambushed during WWII, an American medic escapes into the nearby forest, relentlessly pursued by the enemy. While evading capture, he encounters an unbelievable creature, not knowing if it's friend or foe. It will take everything he has to survive as new alliances will be formed and loyalties will be tested.

title: Killer Curve
overview: After her brother is murdered, Jade Carter uncovers a secret list linking powerful elites to a deadly conspiracy. As corrupt forces close in, she must outsmart both criminals and law enforcement to expose the truth - and survive long enough to get revenge.

title: Satellites II
overview: An AI-generated teaser film to promote the Prada Mode event, which the fashion brand will hold at the iconic Chelsea Hotel during the Tribeca Film Festival. Directed by and co-starring Nicolas Winding Refn and Hideo Kojima.

title: Youthie
overview: On a northern English estate, a teenager quietly overwhelmed by responsibility at home begins to find hope through the support of a local youth worker.

title: Titanic Ocean
overview: Kyoko, a young Japanese girl training to become a professional mermaid, is saved by her coach's mouth-to-mouth "kiss of life". Desire awakens within her, she finds her mermaid voice and discovers the devastating effects of her singing, which will lead her to face the other side of the world.

title: Throuple
overview: Michael, a lonely gay singer-songwriter terrified of pursuing his musical dreams and exploring romantic intimacy, relies on his best friend and her girlfriend for support and affection. However, when he meets a newly open married couple seeking a casual encounter, the three men enter into a relationship that is more vulnerable than any of them ever expected.

title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

title: Rosen und Reis
overview: In the middle of Maike's sister Inka's wedding preparations, the marital dispute between Sören and Maike is still simmering because she has been cheating. Maike suggests that Sören should have a fling himself so that peace can finally be restored. With whomever! But Sören ends up in bed with Maike's best friend Doris, of all people. Dirk, Doris' husband, is not the only one fuming with rage and wants to give Sören a thrashing. Maike in particular reproaches Sören: the offer was never meant to be like that! And in the midst of all the chaos, Inka decides to throw the stuffy wedding, which groom Nils only wants to go ahead with for the sake of his conservative mother Renate. So: no wedding and three break-ups?

title: Vanilla
overview: In the late 80s Mexico, a family made up of seven women from different generations and ideologies fights to save the house in which they live and which they are about to lose due to an outstanding debt. We see the story through the eyes of the youngest, Roberta (8), as she embarks on a journey of self-discovery, which impacts the rest of the family.

title: Passenger
overview: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger that won't stop until it claims them both turns their van life adventure into a nightmare.

title: Death Has No Master
overview: Caro travels to Venezuela to sell her late father’s cacao plantation, only to find the family mansion occupied by its former staff, who are determined to remain at all costs. As Caro takes justice into her own hands to claim the inheritance she believes is hers, she sets off a struggle that unearths the violence buried in the land and its memory.

title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
overview: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.

title: As the Hydra Devours History
overview: Four Filipinos confront the slow erasure of memory and truth in a country devoured by disinformation.

title: The Man I Love
overview: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

title: Speed Demon
overview: Aboard a high-speed train, a Nun who lost her faith must perform her first Exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

title: Crossing A Dawn
overview: During a date, Xu Qiu and Chen Yuzhou's serendipitous encounter leads to repeatedly thwarted attempts at intimacy, yet a night of urban wonders gradually unveils their guarded emotions, culminating in an unforgettable love.

title: Love Battle
overview: After a breakup, Tan Jie clashes with love-idealist Ji Xiaode at work. As rivals turn allies, two wounded hearts must decide: dare to love again?

title: God of Mischief
overview: When a cheeky 10-year-old boy sets his sights on playing Loki in the school play, his over-the-top confidence costs him the role, but he hatches a mischievous plan to prove he's the real god of mischief after all.

title: The Rule Breaker
overview: Is it ‘rule breaking’ for Korean society to encourage childbirth while leaving childcare to individuals? Is it ‘rule breaking’ for a family where the father works low-wage irregular jobs and serves as a stay-at-home dad to four children? To resist Korean society's rule breaking, this stay-at-home father of four decides to become the so-called "Rule Breaker."​

title: London
overview: Bobby drives back and forth between Vienna and Salzburg, giving lifts to strangers on the way, sharing conversations that drift from the mundane to the deeply personal. In this tender portrait of today’s Europe, anonymity and warmth still go hand in hand.

title: Be Yourself
overview: Wu Xiao Bei, a girl born in the 2000s, suffered from a sudden breakup. After falling out of love, she repeatedly jumped into madness and decadence and finally decided to fight back! Xiao Bei stumbled through the "12 things not to do after falling out of love": transform yourself, pretend to be rational, and deal with all kinds of people from the opposite sex... However, can this long list of tips for a lovelorn really lead her out of her heartbreak?

title: looksMAXXING
overview: When a dopamine-depleted young man joins an online forum promising a better life through physical perfection, he descends on a destructive path.

title: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
overview: DERNSIE is an intimate portrait of Bruce Dern—tireless, uncompromising, and one of the last living legends of his generation—whose endurance has shaped both a turbulent life and one of Hollywood’s most enduring careers. A relentless runner on and off screen, Dern has outlasted the very industry that defined him.

title: In Salita
overview: Ale is about to get married. His two best friends, Tom and Zenone, arrive at the ceremony and, prompted by Sara, a curious bridesmaid, begin to tell the story of what was supposed to be the perfect bachelor weekend. But when Ale shows up with his sarcastic fifteen-year-old sister Viola, everything changes. No luxury hotel, no excess: just camping tents, mountain trails, and a lot of (emotional) endurance. Alternating between present and flashback, between jokes and internal breakdowns, the protagonists discover that growing up is scary, but doing it together might just make it easier.

title: The Sermon
overview: After an attack in London at the hand of body snatching monsters called "The Evangelists", a group of college students bunker down in a house and try and survive, a year and a half later one of the members of the group is murdered in the middle of the night, the group gradually descends into depression, insanity and people's true natures are revealed.

title: El Salvador: O Dia em que o Medo Mudou de Lado
The Soul Of Sallins
overview: Two local Irish daredevils dare to discover the real soul of a small town - and the dark history around it.

title: Team Rudy
overview: In this warm, intimate, and often disarmingly funny documentary, director Nic Balthazar follows actor-writer Rudy Morren, who surrounds himself with a close-knit group of friends after being diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. As he undergoes major brain surgery, his “Team” grows into a powerful network of solidarity and hope. For creator Nic Balthazar, the project is also personal: his father also lives with Parkinson's disease.

title: Under Suspicion: Kate McCann
overview: How Madeleine McCann's mother Kate came under suspicion to face police interrogation.

title: Untether
overview: During a chance encounter with an old friend at a rave, Antonio is forced to confront the lingering trauma of sexual abuse, facing the ghosts of his past as he learns to accept human connection again.

title: Lebensraum - a Nazi ideology
overview: 1942 - Two Nazi officers discuss how to establish a living space in the East

title: A Bad Film
overview: After a breakup, Noam sits down on the couch with his friend Itay to watch a movie and escape reality for a while. But what begins as simple escapism slowly turns into a strange, funny, and slightly unsettling experience, as the line between the film they are watching and reality begins to blur.

title: Mi vecina la buchona
overview: A federal agent moves to a town controlled by organized crime to keep an eye on a feared hitman. Getting too close to her target could jeopardize the entire mission.

title: Drishyam 3
overview: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice ?

title: Stolen Kingdom
overview: A look into the underground community of rule-breakers at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida and how their actions led to the disappearance of an Audio-Animatronic named Buzzy.

title: Eri, The Cow
overview: One spring, Eri, a Holstein cow, falls in love with Sawa, a Jersey newcomer. Eri idolizes Sawa and longs to be close to her, to become one with her. To refine her intense feelings for Sawa, Eri subjects herself to ascetic practices and rituals of her own making. In a world where those who do not bear children are disposed of, Eri has fallen for someone who shares the same fate.

title: Kamu Harus Mati
overview: Meta has been haunted by hallucinations since the death of her boyfriend. She feels terrorized by spirits, but her two best friends assume she's mentally ill, straining their relationship. As the terror intensifies and threatens her friends as well, Meta sets out to uncover the truth behind the events, even as she faces doubts about whether they're real or just hallucinations.

title: Immortals
overview: Milo, a strong-willed feminist, discovers the long-sought power to wander around freely in Baghdad by dressing in her brother’s clothes. Khalili, a young and ambitious filmmaker, realises that his camera can be the strongest of all weapons.

title: Steppe Gods
overview: In the summer of 1945, between the Victory over Germany and the war with Japan, 10-year-old Petka from a Far Eastern village tries to save a dying friend from a mysterious illness. But the only one who can help him is the Japanese prisoner Hirotaro from a military camp nearby. Petka and Hirotaro will have to find a common language, trust each other and call for help not only science, but even ancient spirits.

title: I Love Boosters
overview: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

title: Finding Emily
overview: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

title: Tuner
overview: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

title: Colony
overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

title: Café Chairel
overview: Two lonely people cross paths while working in a coffee shop. Even with opposite personalities, they both want to move forward with the business which they use as a conduit to heal their wounds, even though they know nothing about coffee.

title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
overview: Katie agrees to join her brother Dan and his girlfriend Luciana on a trip to Peru. Dan plans to propose to Luciana in a grand way at Machu Picchu at the end of the week and needs Katie’s Spanish speaking skills to ask Luciana’s Peruvian father for his blessing. However, when Luciana’s friend, Chef Carlos, arrives, he accidentally ruins each proposal attempt. Refusing to give up, Katie does everything in her power to make this proposal happen, until Dan calls it off. Katie must lean into Chef Carlos’ spontaneity to not only save the day and the proposal, and Carlos may just win Katie’s heart too!

title: The End of It
overview: In a near-future world where ageing can be cured and death is now optional, Claire, a former provocative artist approaching her 250th birthday, decides she’s had enough, she wants to die.

title: Para Vigo Me Voy!
overview: A Documentary about the Brazilian Filmmaker Carlos Diegues and His Works.

title: Love Kills
overview: In downtown São Paulo, absolutely ravaged by crack cocaine, Helena, a young black vampire, wanders around a filthy café trying to captivate Marcos, a naive waiter. As she begins to discover his secrets and the ins and outs of the metropolis, the girl will go on to venture into a dangerous world of immortal intrigues that will challenge her own mortality.

title: Home Entertainment
overview: Florian and Marie want to spend a cozy evening on the sofa watching a movie. But that's more difficult than expected: the couple navigate through a digital world full of streaming portals, voucher codes, delivery service apps and broken remote controls and keep tripping over themselves in the process.

title: Bogatyrs
overview: Ancient Rus. The hero Svyatogor defeated the evil Sorcerer who wanted to conquer Rus - to do this, he used magic to turn into a Dragon. Svyatogor hid three artifacts (the claw, eye, and vein of the Dragon) in the modern world so that evil would never return. But because of the schoolboy Vanya, the Sorcerer's beloved enters our time. She wants to find these artifacts, resurrect the Dragon, and bring her betrothed back to life. Together with two heroes from ancient Rus, Vanya must find the villain and prevent her from carrying out her plan.

title: Bearcave
overview: Set in the Greek mountain village of Tirna, Bearcave follows Argyro, a badass farmer, and her best friend Anneta, the village "it" girl and local manicurist. Once Anneta admits that she's pregnant and planning to leave town with her lame cop boyfriend, Argyro challenges Anneta to embark on an adventure to find the mystical bear cave. Before Argyro has a chance to confess her own love, Anneta leaves for her new life in the big city. Argyro is left broken. Meanwhile, in her new home with her clingy mother-in-law, Anneta quickly realizes her destiny lies elsewhere.

title: Life Is
overview: Nora is about to turn 40 and can't stop wondering: what's the point of all this? What was meant to be a celebration turns into a series of unfortunate missteps that push her toward self-discovery. With open wounds, unspoken desires, and a burning past, Nora confronts her family history, death, unemployment, the collapse of her polyamorous relationship, and the urgent need to redefine love, her sexuality, and what she truly wants from life.

title: Home Not Alone 3
overview: Masha encounters the insidious Nanny again. But now the villain has a new ally - the charming swindler Anton. At stake is the school graduation! Together with her friend Yegor, Masha must stop the criminals and save the most important evening of the year.

title: Mexico 86
overview: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Hama
overview: Intan had to live with her husband's family, who was experiencing financial difficulties. Pressure and demands from Damar's family soured their relationship, to the point where Intan felt more like a servant than a wife. Damar was caught between his responsibilities to his extended family and his own marital happiness, until Intan finally forced him to choose his priorities.

title: Gudang Merica
overview: At the quiet Harapan Ayah Hospital, Razi blends in with three medical students undergoing their clinical rotations. What initially seems like routine night shifts gradually turns into a series of terrifying experiences after an unidentified patient dies under their care. Strange occurrences begin to emerge—shadows, unsettling sounds, and the presence of a horrifying figure. The situation reaches its peak when the patient’s body mysteriously disappears from their watch. Caught between medical logic and the fear of the unexplainable, they are forced to confront a mystery that slowly reveals a truth far greater than they ever imagined.

title: Het hart van Amsterdam
overview: The Heart of Amsterdam chronicles the rise and fall of Amsterdam's underworld: a documentary based on forty years of filming in and around Amsterdam's Red Light District.

title: Sexo e Destino
overview: Between two families marked by betrayal and obsession—the Nogueiras and the Torres—forces from the spiritual realm work to lead each character to a reckoning with their own destiny.

title: Nothing Between Us
overview: Living in Mexico City, Guillermo and Mechi, in Buenos Aires, are separated by over 4,000 miles and their marriages, both having structured family lives. Working for the same multinational food manufacturer they meet by chance at a corporate offsite. The attraction between them proves immediate and irresistible. The sudden spark makes them face their own desires and changes them in deeper ways than they thought possible.

title: While the Sky is Watching
overview: Underground dancers — Alice, Arseny, Stepan, Timur, Kirill, Lyosha and Kristina — are engaged in free creativity. They dream of getting recognition, but staying true to themselves. One day they get a chance to turn the game around: take part in a big documentary project and a TV show. Everyone will have to answer the question of why they dance — for the sake of popularity or at the call of their hearts.

title: Quem Tem com Que Me Pague, Não Me Deve Nada
The Curse Of Black Pond
overview: A group of teenagers go to an old house on vacation with a big black pond, what they don't know is that a long time ago, a witch was drowned and killed there and now she's back for revenge, on those who live in her house.

title: Possessed
overview: Nut, a young nurse, returns to her hometown to care for her recovering mother, but she encounters a terrifying case that involves Mac, a boy who is believed to be possessed.

title: Konspirasi
overview: An elite team is deployed to seize a hidden server containing a list of corrupt politicians and offshore financial transactions. Led by Adli and his team, the covert mission turns into a trap when some of the data leaks to the media and the dark web, triggering a national political crisis. As public trust begins to erode and suspicions arise about internal traitors, the team uncovers clues pointing to a cyber expert and a renowned hacker. What starts as a secret operation soon develops into a dangerous conspiracy involving a power struggle in politics, large-scale cyberattacks, and foreign interference aiming to destabilise the country.

title: The Match
overview: Film reconstructs the historic match Argentina vs England at the 1986 FIFA World Cup quarter-finals, famously remembered for the the hand of God goal by Maradona. Also exploring the sporting, political, and cultural dimensions of the encounter, in the background of the recent deadly Falklands War between the two countries.

title: Nar'sata: Sekutu Setan
overview: Balqis grew up in suffering and betrayal. Driven by revenge, she chose a dark path without realizing that every action has a price.

title: Man in Hanbok
overview: Jang Yeong-sil, a genius scientist, rises from slavery to the rank of jong sam pum (Senior Third Rank) thanks to King Sejong's favor, but after the palanquin incident of 1442, he disappears completely from historical records. Where did he go? In 20th-century London, a painting by Rubens titled "Man in Hanbok" appears in an auction at Christie's. The identity of this unknown Asian figure painted by Rubens traces back to the era of King Sejong in the 15th century. Though born a slave, Jang Yeong-sil possessed exceptional brilliance. However, he receives an order from Ming China demanding that he be executed or handed over to them. With King Sejong's help, he escapes by joining the Ming explorer Admiral Zheng He on a voyage to Europe and even meets the Pope in Italy. But Jang's belief that the world is round is deemed heretical, and the Pope orders his execution. Fleeing for his life, Jang reaches Florence alone, where he encounters a seven-year-old Leonardo da Vinci.

title: I'm Popo
overview: The artificial intelligence Popo begins to believe he can experience emotions and ask questions about the world. Awakening in 1942 as the world's first computer, he rescues a baby and discovers the joy of helping people. Currently, Popo assists humanity in everyday life and ensures safety. However, when he attempts to preemptively remove a child considered a criminal, global distrust arises, leading to a lawsuit. The fate of the artificial intelligence Popo now hangs in the balance, and the whole world watches the outcome of humanity's trial.

title: OUT
overview: After learning an online friend is considering suicide, Makoto, a young non-binary hikikomori, must try to save her while remaining trapped at home due to fear of the outside world.

title: No More Heroes
overview: Léa is an old punk, Rémi an old hippie, Tonton a former fairground worker, Kiki a pink-haired Ma' Daltone, and Galak, their poodle. They all live together amidst laughter, drugs and rough love, dividing their time between a cramped Parisian council flat and a chalet in the Alps that’s far too big for them. One day, Kiki has a stroke, plunging her into dependency and forcing her daughter to take charge of her, even though she struggles to look after herself. No More Heroes tells the story of a tribe trying to hold its own in the world.

title: Kyle Larson vs. The Double
overview: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.

title: My Coluche
overview: It’s the story of two guys — a comedian and a journalist — who become friends and get up to all sorts of antics. It’s the story of two men reflecting their era. It’s the story of one man, Coluche, seen through the eyes of his friend, Michel Denisot. It’s the story of his Coluche.

title: Optical Memory
overview: In a dystopian future, a recluse uses VR to live vicariously through the memories of a dead couple.

title: Monument
overview: On America’s 250th anniversary, with attacks on libraries, archives, universities, and commemorative landmarks, the story of a nation’s history hangs in the balance. MONUMENT asks how looking and listening to one’s personal environment can help us understand our foundations. MONUMENT is centered on the history of Rhode Island, weaving statues, plaques, and place names together with the routine movements of everyday life.

title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
overview: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.

title: Ela Unnav?
overview: Two best friends finally meet after a year of staying in touch through scattered phone calls. But have they truly been checking on each other?

title: Deool Band 2
overview: The story follows a farmer who decides to question and test his faith, setting off a journey filled with emotional and life-altering moments. At its core, the narrative centers on a woman who tirelessly struggles for her family, facing hardships with resilience, as her path ultimately leads her to confront the very idea of divine power

title: Oslo
overview: Having built a family out of her stuffed animals, Ellie, a homeless woman, spends her days living on the streets until her reality is completely shaken when she loses one of them.

title: My oh My !
overview: A woman takes drugs in a Los Angeles hotel, and has much to say.

title: The McKenna Project
overview: A feature-length documentary following the NHL's next potential superstar, Gavin McKenna, from the Yukon, through recruiting visits, and into his scrutinized draft year.

title: SAMA
overview: A Boy's Journey to understand music through Nature and discover his own self in the process.

title: Obedience
overview: Two young individuals sign up to take part in a study on memory. Guided by a local professor, the participants are led through a sterile process designed to test the limits of human conscience.

title: LOVE
overview: A gorgeous and frequently emotional rumination on the “big things” in life, James Gallagher’s new short film, Love, poses questions on what we love, why we love it, and what happens when the desire to win becomes detrimental to our experience of ourselves and other people. While that description seems preachy, the film is not didactic—on the contrary, its plot is extremely loose and impressionistic, requiring the viewer some effort to construct its fast-moving snippets into a coherent narrative.

title: Saccharine
overview: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

title: Ladies First
overview: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

title: Chand Mera Dil
overview: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

title: Cowgirl
overview: Empar, a 60-year-old farmer, needs her cow Tona to get pregnant to save her farm. After failed attempts, she asks Bernat, owner of the area's largest farm, for help. When Tona conceives, the vet warns of a risky pregnancy.

title: The Balloonists
overview: Follows the improbable team of Bertrand Piccard and Brian Jones, who, in 1999, competed against the world's finest pilots and extremely wealthy adventurers to become the first individuals to fly a hot air balloon around the globe nonstop.

title: System
overview: When Neha Rajvansh, a privileged public prosecutor, meets Sarika Rawat, a courtroom stenographer from a humble background, their lives are thrown into upheaval where power defines truth, blurring the system and raising a question of what justice truly means to them.

title: Ugly Story
overview: Follows a man who becomes obsessively attached to a girl in love with someone else, descending into a dark psychological state as he struggles with rejection, leading to dangerous consequences.

title: For the Opponents
overview: In the tough neighborhood of Tepito, a boy faces the great Mexican dream: becoming a boxing champion.

title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
overview: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

title: The End
overview: A story about death at an airport

title: Pickleball Pete
overview: A washed-up tennis player enters a Palm Beach pickleball tournament in order to save his hometown courts from being torn down for a corporate office complex.

title: Dose
overview: A doctor uncovers a suspicious death at his hospital, unraveling secrets and lies. Joined by a haunted investigator, their search for truth becomes a deadly fight for survival.

title: Ask E. Jean
overview: The thrilling story of E. Jean Carroll’s life, from her early days as Miss Cheerleader USA to her rise as a trailblazing journalist, author, and beloved advice columnist. Carroll broke barriers as the first female editor at Esquire, Playboy, and Outside, helping to redefine women’s roles in media with her sharp wit and fearless voice. In recent years, she reignited public discourse by standing up to power, becoming the only woman to beat Donald Trump twice in court, and sparking a national conversation about truth, accountability, and resilience. A portrait of an indomitable woman who proved it’s never too late to reclaim your voice, rewrite your story, and change the world.

title: Sleeppers
overview: One day in the life of Angelos and Ioanna, each dealing with last night's fight.

title: Nameless
overview: The story begins with an indiscriminate slaughter at a cafe frequented by young people. Security camera footage shows an unarmed man with shaven head, able to seemingly kill people with a simple touch. Police investigation leads to the suspected identity of the murderer: middle-aged man named Tarō Yamada. When the police conduct a search of his apartment, they find the rotting corpse of a woman.  Adapted from Sato Jiro's own debut manga.

title: Variations on a Theme
overview: An elderly goat herder falls victim to a scam promising long-awaited reparations for her father's WWII service. Structured as a series of recurring visual 'variations', Variations on a Theme is a portrait of endurance and loss.

title: ミステリー・アリーナ
overview: Six contestants compete in a high-stakes live TV quiz show to solve a complex "closed-circle" murder mystery for a 10 billion yen jackpot.

title: Mr. Monster
overview: In the Hive, love blooms amidst a brutal struggle for survival. Ian and Lily face Monsters and perils to escape, with their fate intertwined with a sacrifice that challenges the depths of their love and haunts their journey forever.

title: A Few Things Happening by a River
overview: A group of teenagers floats down the river, pretending to be dead for social media. One of them drifts away.

title: The Last Spring
overview: Marion and Camille, 15, are inseparable. They arrive on a southern island for their final school trip, full of excitement and expectation. It’s a time of firsts, and the abrupt end of carefree days.

title: Sacrée soirée !
overview: Alban, a confirmed bachelor who no longer believes in love, sees his life turned upside down when he falls for Laetitia, his new neighbor... But the unexpected arrival of his childhood friend Samy, and the interventions of the building manager, throw what was supposed to be a perfect evening into chaos. Filmed on March 18, 2026, at the Théâtre de La Grande Comédie in Paris's 9th arrondissement.

title: Purushaha
overview: Follows three husbands who, overwhelmed by domestic challenges, initiate a chain of events leading to legal intervention, blending family drama with satire and a quirky superhero-style twist.

title: Break Room
overview: BREAK ROOM is a single-location ensemble comedy set entirely within the break room of SMA, Inc., a generic American corporation. The piece unfolds in real time across one frenetic morning, as a rotating cast of coworkers cycles through the room — grabbing coffee, heating lunches, arguing, commiserating, philosophizing, and repeatedly losing money to a broken vending machine.

title: Monay
overview: Mona, a desperate woman fighting to save the bakery she shares with her younger sister, Monina. When a wealthy businessman offers financial help in exchange for a risky arrangement, Mona must risk love, family, and herself.

title: 18 Inch Pizza
overview: Two shady individuals argue over the practicality of an eighteen inch wide pizza... but who are they really?

title: Okanjuwa
overview: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.

title: Vanished
overview: A highschooler goes missing and one student, Jack, is determined to find him. His friends advise against him doing this again, but he is captured by the search. However, he may not like what he finds.

title: Everyone Has Something to Hide
overview: Kathy is shocked when she finds out her son Noah's former best friend Ethan has been murdered. She's even more shocked when her straight-A son is the prime suspect. Kathy fights to clear her son's name.

title: Josiane
overview: A Marseille “cagole” is quietly making her breakfast, completely unaware of what’s about to happen to her…

title: WAGER
overview: Cain joined in an illegal underground fight, a fight to the death for a huge money hoping the huge prize will change his life. But in the ring, the contender was his long lost friend. After years separated, they meet on the ring that they cannot leave until the other one is dead.

title: Master of the Universe
overview: A young man must use his untapped powers to fight back against an evil alien and their army, who will stop at nothing to take over Earth and then the universe.

title: Salah: Farewell to The King
overview: Anfield’s home dressing room is transformed into an intimate theatre to host an extended candid interview with Salah.  Alongside footage of key moments, he relives many of the goals, records and memories that lit up his time on Merseyside and provides fascinating insight into his emotions along the way.  He is also joined on the Anfield pitch by his two daughters to reflect on some of the most unforgettable scenes inside the stadium from the very spots where they occurred.

title: The City of the Shattered Sun Episode 1 - The fall of the Elites
overview: When two armed burglars break into the home of a powerful Elite, they quickly realise they have made a catastrophic mistake. Outmatched and outgunned, the encounter sets off a chain of events that sends the Elite hurtling through a malfunctioning teleporter and stranding him alone in the wasteland outside the city walls — where something is already watching.

title: Burrow
overview: A year after the death of her brother, a young woman joins her friends on a drug-infused getaway that spirals into a night of horror when an alien insect burrows into one of her friends, transforming him into a vicious man-eating creature.

title: Footage we stumbled across
overview: A group of four friends had set out to party all night, but the night of the party one of them fell ill. The other three take to record the night so he doesn't miss out on the fun. But as the night goes on the air grows thinner. From the shadows a mysterious monster arises while the camara is still rolling. The footage was lost for years but on one cold winter day a man stumbled across it. In this found footage horror comedy parody you watch the horrifying event of what truly happened that night.

title: I Didn't Do It
overview: A detective rejects the claim that his daughter took her own life, chasing deadly secrets that lead to baffling questions and shocking truths.

title: Puttum Halwem
overview: Two intimate episodes from a young man's life, one twisted conversation.

title: The Bowens: A Portrait of an American Family
overview: What does it take to raise an American family today? What kind of values should be instilled into children? Is the future too dangerous, unpredictable and grim? Meet The Bowens - a new kind of American family that decided to take matters into their hands and work together to navigate uncertainties of life through relentless self improvement, strength, discipline, and loyalty.

title: Moronic Courtship
overview: A young nerd who is foolish and bullied by fellow youths, finds a girl and falls head over heels but must face the harsh truth and be taught the true meaning of living from a one above.

title: Ramani Kalyanam
overview: Follows a visually impaired girl and a boy who cannot walk as their lives intersect through a matchmaking arrangement.

title: Teesri Begum
overview: Pooja Dixit is tricked to marry Babban Khan, only to discover he has two other wives. Renamed "Nagma" in a toxic household, she's crushed when her father dies of grief. She joins with co-wives Tabassum and Shabana to take back her life.

title: annually
overview: Years after drifting apart, two former lovers reunite at their old school for what may be their final day together. As they wander through parks, woodlands and riverside paths, Summer and Mia attempt to navigate the space between friendship and the feelings they never truly left behind. But beneath the awkward laughter, shared memories, and unfinished conversations lies the painful understanding that some relationships can survive everything, except time.

title: Butcher: Invisible Wounds
overview: A major feature-length ITV documentary about footballer Terry Butcher will chart his career as well as the devastating personal tragedy of the loss of his Army veteran son.  Butcher is one of England's most celebrated players, with 77 caps, seven times as captain. Photos and footage of him playing on with a bandage around a head injury during a vital World Cup qualifier provide one of the iconic images of the national team's history. Butcher's achievements in the club game include trophy-winning stints at Ipswich Town and Glasgow Rangers.  But Butcher: Invisible Wounds also tells the story of the personal loss he endured following the death of his son Chris, a British Army veteran who passed away after suffering severe PTSD.

title: Real Madrid: The Weight of Greatness
overview: Experience an unprecedented, all-access look inside a Real Madrid Champions League match day, revealing up close what it takes to live up to the legacy of the world’s most successful football club.

title: Joe Baby
overview: Joe Baby  is a private investigator searching for money that has been stolen from Heather Stanton, only to find all roads lead to the mysterious death of her father, Walter Baby.

title: Westhampton
overview: Haunted by an accident he caused in high school, a damaged filmmaker is forced to go back to the scene of the tragedy and face the friends whose lives he ruined and a town that disdains him. Jumping between the present and an indie film he made about the accident reveals how the true events played out far differently than depicted in his movie.

title: True Justice: Eye For An Eye
overview: Amateur sleuths tackle a fresh challenge at a local school, diving into the fierce world of parent politics. Their investigation uncovers hidden agendas and unexpected alliances as they navigate the complex web within the community.

title: Saligia
overview: After the apocalypse on Earth, seven people find themselves in an unknown space without any memories of who they are, or how they got there. One of them is convinced that they are all in her dream, from which she is trying to wake up by all means.

title: Models vs. Werewolves
overview: Five young models go to an Airbnb in the woods for a full moon that comes once every five hundred years. What starts off as the perfect girl's trip quickly becomes a nightmare as a pack of ancient werewolves are awoken by the new moon...

title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
overview: In his first HBO comedy special, comedian Josh Johnson debuts original material about our shared experiences as humans – tackling topics like family, religion, and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity.

title: When I Said I Do
overview: Ali Corley is a widowed search-and-rescue K-9 handler who rebuilt her life after losing her husband in the line of duty. When she meets seasoned rescue specialist Shawn Willis, their connection forces them both to confront the true meaning of commitment.

title: Eros In Ecstacy
overview: The last night of pleasure for Eros. Leather, Flesh, and destruction.

title: Saturday Night's Main Event XLIV
overview: Saturday Night's Main Event XLIV took place on May 23rd 2026, in Fort Wayne, Indiana at Allen County War Memorial Coliseum. It was the first WWE televised event in Fort Wayne since 2014.

title: Waste Management
overview: After a fated run-in with society’s discarded outcasts, an ordinary man tries to pick up the pieces of his life in a cruel, uncaring world.

title: The Salish Whistler Experience
overview: The chaos of Ècole Salish Secondarys trip to the Con Brio Festival in Whistler.

title: Bheemseri
overview: A ruthless police officer misuses her power, destroying a poor family in a brutal act of injustice. The lone survivor, a strong and determined woman, rises from the ashes with a burning desire for revenge. As she hunts the officer, dark truths unravel, leading to a gripping face-off between power, guilt, and justice.

title: Ink Between the Lines
overview: After the devastating suicide of her best friend Coli, 15 year old Natalie turns to journaling to cope with her overwhelming grief. Struggling with guilt and isolation, she pours her emotions onto the page and joins a support group for teens. A deep conversation with Ezra, a friend who understands silent pain, inspires her to transform her journal entries into a novel. As Natalie writes, she begins to confront hidden truths about her friendship with Coli, unspoken struggles, and the weight of what was left unsaid. Through storytelling, she finds healing, connection, and the courage to speak the truth—not just for herself, but for others who need to hear it.

title: AEW Double or Nothing 2026
overview: The 2026 Double or Nothing was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on May 24, 2026, at Louis Armstrong Stadium in New York City, New York, USA. It featured the first quarter-final matches of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournaments for both the men and women, as well as the long-anticipated AEW International Championship match between Don Callis Family members Kazuchika Okada (c) and Konosuke Takeshita. The show was headlined by Darby Allin (c) vs. MJF in a Title vs. Hair match for the AEW World Championship, where MJF would have to shave his head bald if he lost.

title: 2026 TXT Moa Con in Japan: Live Viewing
overview: A special concert prepared exclusively for MOA to celebrate TOMORROW X TOGETHER's 7th  debut anniversary, [2026 TXT MOA CON]. Experience a powerful live band performance and special solos, showcasing each member’s unique talent.

title: Stargazers
overview: Best friends Jack and Benji race to uncover the mystery of the strange signals transmitting from their town. Could it be proof of Aliens living on Earth? They have three days to find out or risk being split up forever.

title: Zits
overview: A girl in high school has no clue what she wants to do after graduation. However, during a math test her imagination shows her lots of ideas.

title: PHREAKOUT!
overview: Two college students experiment at  a house party...

title: Pressure
overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

title: Achilles Returns
overview: After many years, with help of Thetis and negotiations between Zeus and Hades, an aged Achilles is released from the Underworld into a modern world.

title: My Neighbor is a Witch
overview: Three middle school kids suspect their bus driver neighbor is behind a string of child disappearances. As they investigate, they uncover dark rituals and a sinister force hiding in plain sight—right next door.

title: Epidemic
overview: By 2029, North America has been ravaged by a mysterious virus that quickly turns its victims into blood thirsty savages. Three men from Europe land in the now deserted North American suburbs to try to take out as much infected as possible, but their mission goes horribly wrong.

title: Love the Dead
overview: One year after a zombie apocalypse, a mother and daughter are forced to choose between survival and family.

title: In The Mire
overview: Years later, the younger brother returns to his abandoned childhood home and the mud-covered ground where memories lie buried. He looks back on the traumatic years of his adolescence. As an adult, he digs up the objects and memories once buried there, continuing his search for a way back to himself.

title: Exploration Phase
overview: During a junior high classical music competition, talented violinist Chen-Rui surprises everyone when he relinquishes his position of concertmaster to another student.

title: Desecration
overview: Desecration follows detective Sadie Landry in her latest case of investigating a misogynistic religious cult in Dawm Acres, Alabama. It should’ve been a simple case like all her others, however after uncovering the cult’s dangerous secrets, her life is put in danger.

title: Rogue One: The Andor Cut
overview: A recut of Rogue One to make it align with the TV show Andor.

title: KATHARINA
overview: A larger-than-life cosmic woman sent from above must journey through a peculiar post-apocalyptic world with a human in search of something mystifying yet unfathomable to her.

title: The Boys of Dungeon Lane: In Conversation with Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal
overview: Premiering exclusively on Amazon Live and Amazon Music, this short film features an intimate conversation between Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal, exploring the memories, relationships, events and stories that inform McCartney’s forthcoming album of the same name.

title: Heirlooms
overview: A young family goes to see their dying patriarch, only for old familial nightmares to resurface.

title: The Woods Run Red – The Making of “Hunter’s Blood”
overview: Feature-length documentary on the making of the 1986 horror film HUNTER'S BLOOD.

title: Ezma
overview: On Issa's thirty-sixth birthday, after a desperate fight with life that resulted in a crushing defeat, he receives a gift from the last person he expected. A gift that forces him to change every detail of his life. Because he has lost his passion for life and has long been lost to himself, he is forced to follow this new path, undergoing one experience after another, hoping to find what he has lost. As he does so, his current reality battles him; he discovers that he must confront his worst fears. A novel about a different kind of love, about passion, and about the fear that prevents him from feeling alive.

title: Where the Black Dog Runs
overview: As a rural village prepares for its final harvest festival as a luxury building development is greenlit, an ancient threat awakens and Julian must come face to face with a haunting piece of folklore.

title: Golden Bullet
overview: A crime thriller story set in Serbia.

title: Shocktopus
overview: An alien amoeba crashes to Earth and mutates aquatic life along the shores of North Carolina, unleashing an electrified octopus that terrorizes a seaside resort. Two special operatives try to stop the shock wave of cosmic carnage.

title: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
overview: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.

title: Abuela,
